external_games.name: 鸳鸯风云录——白中悬案(Phoenix sword: The Hidden Scroll)

name: Phoenix Sword: The Hidden Scroll
summary: In 1630, Ming Dynasty collapses—famine, war, and rebellion plague the land. When a tyrant is murdered in "utopian" Baichu County, detectives Yue Wuxi and Feng Shengjue investigate, unwittingly uncovering a conspiracy that will shake both court and martial world...
